Powerful dragons known as the 4 Dragons of the Apocalypse form the first Tiamat and begin a multi front war against the mortals of Terra-Nova using their own power and armies of Dragonborn and Kobolds. 4 Heroes from different parts of the world unite and become known as the Wyrm-Wardens. They work together to defeat the dragons and save civilization by defeating the 4 dragons. The Dragonborn are freed from their dark influence and join the sentient races of Terra-Nova.
